meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Pairs with a deployment skill such as vercel-cli, where one is installed.

copy.tagline: 确保每个网页项目在交付前都通过构建、测试与真实浏览器验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是前端开发者,希望每个网页项目在交付前都得到系统性验证。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure every web project passes build, test, and real-browser verification before delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a frontend developer wanting a systematic verification workflow before delivering web projects.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 处理网页项目时会严格按固定流程：先读代码、再编码、构建并修复错误，然后用浏览器截图在桌面和移动端验证，全部通过才宣布完成，并给出截图、线上地址和遗留问题。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、修改或优化网站、网页应用等前端项目时，它就会接管并按此流程执行。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品介绍网页，先按流程做，最后截图确认。
say.note: 它会按要求开发并截图验证。

say.text: 修改这个项目的样式，记得跑构建和浏览器验证。
say.note: 它会调整样式，然后重新构建并验证。

say.text: 部署到线上后，打开线上地址截图看看有没有问题。
say.note: 它会在部署后验证线上页面是否正常。

howto.what_en: After install, it follows a fixed workflow: read code, write code, build & fix errors, verify via browser screenshots (desktop/mobile). It declares done only after all checks pass, then reports screenshots, live URL, known issues.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to create, modify, or optimize a website, web app, or other frontend project, it takes over and applies this workflow.

say_en.text: Create a product page, follow your workflow, and confirm with screenshots.
say_en.note: It will build, test, and screenshot the result.

say_en.text: Modify this project's styles, run the build, and verify in a browser.
say_en.note: It will adjust styles, build, and re-verify.

say_en.text: After deploying, open the live URL and take a screenshot to check for issues.
say_en.note: It will verify the live site after deployment.
